agent_summary: Customer reports a failed transaction where money was debited from their AXIS account and requests a reversal. No transaction ID provided. Confidence is 0.6, which is at the threshold; policy says below 0.6 routes to human. Human-only categories do not apply, but the missing txn_id and lack of transactions in context means we cannot auto-resolve. We should route to a human team to trace the debit and process the reversal.
customer_reply_draft: Sorry for the trouble. Since you haven't shared the transaction ID, I'm unable to trace the debit and process the reversal right now. A specialist will review your AXIS account and contact you shortly with the next steps.
next_action_for_human: Trace the debit from the customer's AXIS account, identify the transaction, and process the reversal. Also verify if any compensation is due based on RBI TAT.

proposed_actions.name: send_reply
proposed_actions.rationale: No txn_id provided, so we cannot auto-reverse. Policy requires human tracing of the debit before reversal.
